mission: Jedi Temple training session — Jacen teaches Ben a kata; Ben trusts; Jacen watches with something not quite pride.
why_now: Jacen uses training sessions as one-on-one time with Ben that sits outside the Order's formal apprenticeship structure.
opening_hook: Jacen demonstrating the kata while Ben copies from three meters away.
conflict: Ben's apprentice uncertainty vs. Jacen's gentle authority (external calm masking interior priorities).
turning_point: Ben completes the kata clean; Jacen watches and says 'good' — and the compliment lands more heavily on Ben than Jacen's interior registers.
closing_hook: Jacen racking his saber; Ben standing at the training room's center holding his own saber carefully.
setting: Jedi Temple training room, Coruscant; empty.
sensory_details: Saber hum; rubberized floor; Ben's breath after the kata.
emotional_trajectory: Focused training → landed compliment → quiet deference.

stakes.external: The developing interior asymmetry that will bend Ben.

notes: Ben's positive-change arc is inside Jacen's corruption arc.
